shortDescription: Emergent RimWorld harassment/bondage/control addon for RimJobWorld: abuse-gated conditioning with per-pawn susceptibility, a floating "Command deck" Harem window, weekly pet market, world-incident + notoriety layer (Karma integration), Tales, Ideology + Biotech integration, blackmail photos, a per-tick pawn-index performance framework, and broad mod compat.
body:
# RimJobWorld - Sexual Harassment C# addon for **RimJobWorld** (hard dep) + **Harmony**. Emergent harassment adapted from AAF Sexual Harassment (F4). Soft deps: SpeakUp, RimTalk, Karma & Reputation, c0ffee Animations, Melee Animation, [NL] Facial Animation, Onahole Extension, Rimpsyche, Modern Bio Tab, Simple Slavery Collars, BondageBed Torture, RJW Quirks/Sexperience/Genes. DLC-aware: Ideology + Biotech layers load only when active (LoadFolders IfModActive). ## Workflow rule (global) Before ANY movement/rename/delete of source files, versioned timestamped backup to `D:\Rimworld\\\`. D: = /d in git-bash. Global rules live in `_dev\GLOBAL_RULES.md` (read via bash - outside the workspace guard). Key engineering rules: **Frameworks Over Duplicated Code** (dedup, route through shared caches/bridges) and **Robust On Error** (try/catch every tick/entry point, kill-switch + fail-open). Finish work with 4 passovers + an honest 1-100% confidence score per fix. ## AUDIT: Docs/QuadPass_Audit_2025.md (+ .pdf, 12pp) - NOTHING BUILT YET Quadruple-pass static audit (perf / IMGUI-VRAM / compat / frameworks). Regenerate the PDF with `python Docs/_mkpdf.py Docs/QuadPass_Audit_2025.md Docs/QuadPass_Audit_2025.html` then Edge `--headless=new --print-to-pdf` (Windows paths + `file:///` URL required). **Top findings awaiting approval, in priority order:** 1. **C1 (97%)** `ModLister.GetActiveModWithIdentifier` needs `ignorePostfix: true` - Steam mods carry `ModMetaData.SteamModPostfix = "_steam"`. Only the Karma probe passes it, so **6 of 11 soft-dep probes are false on this machine** (FacialAnim, SpeakUp, RimTalk, SimpleSlaveryCollars, BondageBed, Rimpsyche-Sexuality) - those bridges are dead code today. 2. **U1 (95%)** `Window_Harem.DrawStage` passes the unquantised, resize-derived frame size to `PortraitsCache.Get`. RimWorld pools expired portrait RenderTextures and NEVER destroys them outside `PortraitsCache.Clear()`, so one resize drag strands ~225-450 MB of VRAM for the session. Fix = quantise to 16 px, draw scaled into the exact rect. 3. **U5 (99%)** Zero scroll culling anywhere in Window_Harem; Harem rows are 200 px tall (40 base + 160 schedule) and all are drawn every pass. 4. **U2 (93%)** `_stageZoom` lerp animates `cameraZoom` -> up to 44 live stage-sized RTs (~66 MB spike) per Stylist open. Fix = animate the destination Rect, not the camera zoom. 5. **U10 (99%)** `Patch_HaremResizeGrip` postfixes `Verse.Window.WindowOnGUI` globally (every window, every IMGUI event) to draw 3 lines. `WindowOnGUI` is `public virtual` - override it in Window_Harem and delete the patch. 6. **U4 (90%)** `DrawPortrait`/`DrawStageDoll` are not `EventType.Repaint`-gated (the two Dialogs are) -> 2-6x redundant `PawnCacheRenderer` renders/frame on dirty pawns. 7. **U8 (98%)** `AllPets()`+`FilterSortPets()` rebuild per IMGUI event (2-6x/frame): cross-map scan, 5 list allocs, `ToLowerInvariant()` per pawn, `List.Contains` O(n^2). 8. **T1 (98%)** Four heavy passes converge on `% 2500` (ConditioningUpkeep + RecomputeHeadGirls + ControlUpkeep breakoutTick + GameComponent profile loop) -> ~41 s periodic hitch. Fix = phase offsets. 9. **T2 (99%)** Five periodic scans (RecomputeHeadGirls, HeadGirlTick, MemoryReactionScan, EvilKeyScavenge, PhotoScavenge) still use raw `AllPawnsSpawned` instead of the existing `_humanlikes`/`_profiled` index. 10. **C3 (90%)** `FindLockedVictimForKey` statics are keyed on a live `CompHoloCryptoStamped` ref and store `Pawn` values -> roots a dead Game graph across save/load (the exact trap `PawnFlagCache` was written to avoid). 11. **F1 (99%)** UI widgets (GrayButton/MiniHeader/bars/portrait/colour-tex cache) duplicated across Window_Harem, Dialog_DressUp, Dialog_Stylist, SexualityPanelDrawer - no shared widget layer. This is what let the 8 distinct portrait sizes proliferate. **Correction to the premise recorded in the audit:** IMGUI is not the VRAM consumer - `PortraitsCache` RenderTextures are. IMGUI's cost here is draw calls + CPU. UIToolkit is NOT viable in 1.6 (cannot interleave with `Verse.WindowStack`). **Proposed tranches:** A free wins (~60 lines, zero risk) / B VRAM+frame time (~85) / C shared UI framework (~250) / D tick hygiene + compat depth. Unexploited **active** integrations catalogued in the doc: Vanilla Skills Expanded ExpertiseDefs (Phase E, confirmed installed), Suppression + PrisonersDontHaveKeys (risk/overlap - check first), Nudity Matters More, Privacy Please, RimHUD, Grudges!, Rimpsyche-Disposition, Restraints/SimpleRestraintBelt, Epitaph/In Memoriam, VSIE, MorePrecepts/AlphaMemes. ## Facial Animation integration (FacialAnimation/Defs/FaceAnims_Harassment.xml) - loads IfModActive Nals.FacialAnimation Two classes of FaceAnimationDef: - **PERSISTENT (thought-gated):** RJWSH_FA_Nervous/_Afraid/_Hollow/_Devoted. No targetJobs (defaults to ConstantJob = ambient), but gated by `targetThoughtDefs` (+ mood range on _Hollow), so FA only shows them while the pawn carries the matching moodlet. Same pattern as FA's own Thought_Naked. - **ONE-SHOT (played from C# via FABridge.PlayTemporaryAnimation):** RJWSH_FA_Flinch/_Cry/_Bliss, priority 400. **GOTCHA (fixed):** FaceAnimationDef's ctor defaults targetJobs to ["ConstantJob"], and FA applies any ConstantJob def that has NO targetThoughtDefs to EVERY pawn every tick - so these one-shots were pinning every FA colonist's face into a permanent flinch/cry/bliss. Fix = give each a sentinel `
  • RJWSH_NeverAmbient
    • ` (not "ConstantJob", not any real JobDef defName) - removes them from all ambient lists while PlayTemporaryAnimation still works (it bypasses the job dict, adds straight to forcedTemporaryAnimationList). FABridge.PlayFace also plays FA's own job-gated "Strip" face during the strip driver. ## Performance framework (PawnIndex.cs) Central caching layer to keep TPS impact minimal (caching/dictionaries/frameworks per user request). - **Per-tick pawn index (on MapComponent_HarassmentScan):** `EnsureIndex()` rebuilds, at most once per game tick (stamp = TicksGame), a `Dictionary _byId` + snapshot lists `_humanlikes` and `_profiled`. `PawnById(id)` is O(1). This **killed the old O(n^2)** control upkeep. The upkeep loops iterate `_profiled` (ControlUpkeep, BegUpkeep) or `_humanlikes` (ConditioningUpkeep, AffectionUpkeep). **Gap found in audit (T2): the five interval scavenger/head-girl/memory passes still bypass it.** - **PawnLookup (static):** `OnMap(map,id)` / `AnyMap(id)` route through each map's index. Replaced all 4 duplicated linear `FindPawnById` scans. - **PawnFlagCache (static, tick-scoped memo):** memoizes `WearingControlCollar` / `WearingSlaveryCollar` / `IsInOnaholeBed`. Keys are pawn ids (never Pawn refs -> no dead-Game-graph leak); store clears on tick turnover; collar equip/remove sites call `PawnFlagCache.Invalidate`. Self-healing: a missed Invalidate is at worst a one-pass-stale bool. ## Performance settings (Settings.cs / Mod.cs) - conservative defaults New "Performance" section in mod options: - **enableDepthSystems** (default ON) - master toggle for the heaviest per-pet layer. When OFF, core break-in progression + visible hediffs still run. - **enableAmbientBanter** (default ON) + **ambientBanterScale** (default **0.6**) - gates + scales idle pet flavor chatter. The captive "help" cry is NOT gated. - **affectionInterval** (default **3000**); **begInterval** (default 450). 0 disables either. ## EXPANSION ROADMAP (user-approved 10-idea list, phases A-E) - **A (DONE):** #7 notoriety/Karma-reputation + #1 Tales. - **B (DONE):** #2 per-pawn chronicle + #3 owner death & legacy. - **C (DONE):** #4 nemesis arc + #6 blackmail. - **D (DONE):** #8 Ideology rituals + #5 interactive training. - **E (next):** #10 Devoted endgame roles as VSE ExpertiseDefs (Bodyguard=Melee, Handler=Social, Courtesan=Sex-skill w/ Sexperience, hediff fallback without VSE) + #9 Hospitality integration. **Audit confirms Vanilla Skills Expanded (`vanillaexpanded.skills`) is installed and active.** ## Target selection & attraction (HarassmentEngine.cs) `TryRunOnMap` weighted-picks a harasser (HarasserWillingness) then `FindTarget` builds a victim pool. **Sex/orientation gate = `IsAttracted(harasser,target)` (public):** absolute opposite-sex override (enforceOppositeSex/heterosexualOnly), downed-hostile opportunism ignores orientation, else RJW discrete orientation. **Approach re-validates sex:** `JobDriver_Harass` re-checks `IsAttracted` during the walk (FailOn) AND at arrival. Player-directed grope/force bypasses the re-check. ## Interactive training (Phase D - #5 - Window_TrainingSession.cs) Setting `interactiveTraining` (default ON): the Command deck **Discipline** button opens a read-the-pet minigame. 3 rounds: pet is in a hidden state (Defiant/Fearful/Yearning) leaked by a "tell"; owner picks Firm/Gentle/Degrade. Correct match deepens conditioning + lowers subDom; misread piles trauma. ## Ideology rituals (Phase D - #8) Two optional rites gated to the **RJWSH_Ownership meme**: collaring ceremony + devotion parade. PLAYER-initiated, ROLE-LESS gather-party, outcome worker subclasses RitualOutcomeEffectWorker_FromQuality. **UNTESTED IN-GAME - highest-risk surface.** ## Tales / Chronicle / Owner death / Nemesis / Blackmail - Tales: `TaleHelper.Record` null-guarded; 6 TaleDefs at milestones. - Chronicle: `PawnProfile.chronicle` (cap 100), History tab in Command deck. - Owner death: Harmony Postfix on Pawn.Kill -> OnOwnerDied (grief/hypnosis-shed/heir). - Nemesis: escaped/sold pets return as raid leaders (MTB by grudge). - Blackmail: photo gizmo -> faction demand; pay/refuse branches; notoriety. - Shared raid helpers: `SpawnAssaultRaid` / `PickRaidFaction`. ## Notoriety x Karma & Reputation (ReputationBridge in Bridges.cs) `AddNotoriety(amt, reason)` = local 0-100 meter + mirror -amt*3 colony infamy. World-incident pacing scales with colony regard. No-ops without Karma. ## Harem window (Window_Harem.cs) - "Command deck" FLOATING Window (Modern Suite, accent-LEFT tabs). Left roster + center STAGE / MARKET PODIUM + right OPS (Commands, Schedule, Context tabs Feed/Graph/History/[Profile]/Social) + COLONY OPS. FindPawnById routed through PawnLookup.AnyMap. **2761 lines; audit findings U1-U11 all live here.** ## Pet market / Conditioning / Break stages GameComponent.market weekly; BuyMarketPawn -> collar to StrongestOrLeader. Collar SEVERITY grants Masochist/Stockholm (abuse-gated + susceptibility). BreakStage {Defiant,Wavering,Compliant,Devoted,Broken}. Escape/sale/rescue -> RegisterNemesis. **`GameComponent.profiles` has no pruning path (audit T5) - grows unbounded and is deep-Scribed into every save.** ## Settings (Settings.cs / Mod.cs) masterEnabled, enableSounds, interactiveTraining, showControlTab, showSexualityTab (default OFF), hideKeyHolderGizmos, enableFleeBeating/BeatToDeath, conditioningInstallsQuirks/Gene, **Performance: enableDepthSystems, enableAmbientBanter, ambientBanterScale, affectionInterval, begInterval**, etc. ## Conventions Vanilla sentence case, ASCII hyphen only. Event.current not Input. **UI = Modern Suite.** Harmony PatchAll (astryl.RJWSexualHarassment). Rituals: player-started + role-less + FromQuality subclass ONLY. **Attraction/sex gate = HarassmentEngine.IsAttracted (public).** **Perf: id->Pawn via PawnLookup/PawnById (per-tick index), hot apparel/bed predicates via PawnFlagCache; never re-add a linear AllPawnsSpawned scan for an id lookup.** **FA: any one-shot FaceAnimationDef (played via PlayTemporaryAnimation) MUST carry a sentinel targetJobs so it stays out of FA's ambient ConstantJob rotation.** **Soft-dep probes MUST pass `ignorePostfix: true` (Steam `_steam` suffix).** **Never pass an unquantised, resize-derived size to `PortraitsCache.Get`.** Test companions: astryl.KarmaReputation, astryl.ModernBioTab, rjw.quirks, rjw.sexperience, Vegapnk.rjw.genes, TRIBeagle.simpleslaverycollars, Mlie.BondageBedTorture (+ Ludeon.RimWorld.Ideology).
